name: Hucow Tiffany's First Milking
source:
A week after the birth of her first child, Tiffany Column, a cow-aspected woman, realizes something horrific: Even the inside of her body shares in the traits of dairy cows. Milk production doesn't stop even when full. They are growing. It's getting painful, her skin is cracking.

And yet she can't tell anyone, a deep shame stops her, she doesn't want to be milked like a cow, she wants to be normal.

[From [url=https://atinylittlecloud.itch.io/tiffany-the-hucow-firsts-milking]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在她的第一个孩子出生一周后，蒂芙尼·科伦（Tiffany Column），一位与牛相像的女人，意识到了一些可怕的事情：甚至她的身体内部也有奶牛的特征。即使吃饱了，产奶也不会停止。他们正在成长。越来越痛，她的皮肤都在开裂。

但她不能告诉任何人，深深的羞耻阻止了她，她不想像牛一样被挤奶，她想成为正常人。

[来自[url=https://atinylittlecloud.itch.io/tiffany-the-hucow-firsts-milking]itch.io[/url]]
